data.one_liner: Provides modern Handy-style windows with rounded bottom corners on Linux.
data.what_it_does: The package replaces the default Flutter window on Linux with a libhandy‑styled window that has rounded bottom corners. It works by adjusting the native GTK code before the Flutter view is shown.
use_when: Building a Flutter desktop app for Linux that should match the Ubuntu/GTK look
Needing rounded‑corner windows without writing custom GTK code
avoid_when: Targeting Windows, macOS, or web platforms
Running on Linux distributions without libhandy or GLib ≥ 2.58
strengths: Simple Dart API – just add the dependency
weaknesses: Linux‑only; no support for other desktop platforms
Requires manual changes to C runner files
Limited to Ubuntu 20.04+ due to libhandy version
data.setup_notes: Add handy_window to pubspec.yaml and modify linux/runner/my_application.cc (or linux/my_application.cc for older Flutter) to call fl_register_plugins before showing the window, as shown in the README.

alternatives.name: gtk
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level GTK bindings for custom window handling without the Handy‑specific styling
